items.difficulty_reason: Vanishing lemma (statement 3045-3056, proof 3058-3100): a map K -> K' out of a cartesian object inducing zero on K_0 is zero, proved by a Postnikov-system induction - the start uses the g_{n!} identification of cartesian objects (card L46169), the step uses assumption (2) on the distinguished triangles, and the hocolim reduction uses assumption (3); no verification is omitted. H2: derived-category induction with explicit vanishing hypotheses.
